seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Avon, Indiana for 2026: 7 family events, 3 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Avon kicks off Christmas with a tree lighting and carriage rides at Blue Heron Park, then fills December with Santa breakfasts, workshops and a Polar Express Experience.
celebrates: Avon Parks and Recreation leads the season with its tree lighting and carriage rides at Blue Heron Park, the park on U.S. Highway 36 that was formerly called Avon Town Hall Park. The same department runs Santa's Workshop for a child and one adult, and the Polar Express Experience takes over Washington Township Park. Pecar Nature Center and Pecar Park host Santa programs and a chimney craft night, listed on the Visit Hendricks County calendar, while Avon Schools list a Breakfast with Santa at Bartlett Chapel. Plainfield and Brownsburg sit next door, so many Avon families also add an event or two across the town line.
lastyear: Avon Parks and Recreation hosted its 2025 Christmas tree lighting at Avon Town Hall Park. The department's social posts described a schedule with the arrival of Santa, a scavenger hunt, crafts and horse-drawn carriage rides, plus performances by the Prezettes and local vendors as the park filled with twinkling lights. The 2025 carriage rides cost $10 a person, and the 2026 listing now carries a higher carriage price, so check the details on each card before you go.
facts: The tree lighting park has had two names. The town calendar called it Avon Town Hall Park when it hosted the tree lighting in 2022, and now lists the same park at 6570 E U.S. Highway 36 as Blue Heron Park. That 2022 event offered food trucks, free crafts, carolers and a visit with Santa, and the town asked families to bring their own camera for photos. Today the town says it offers a limited number of carriage rides around the lake during the tree lighting.
trains: Avon does not have a Christmas train of its own, though the Polar Express Experience at Washington Township Park gives kids the story and the spirit. For a real ride, the closest listing in our guide is Nickel Plate Express in Forest Park in Noblesville, on the north side of the Indianapolis area, which runs trains in the Christmas season including the Reindeer Express. Check that page for dates and tickets, because train seats tend to sell out before December.

faq: When is the Avon tree lighting in 2026?

Avon Parks and Recreation holds the tree lighting and carriage rides on Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 4 to 6 pm at Blue Heron Park. Attending is free. The town says it offers a limited number of carriage rides around the lake, and each ride is a separate cost, so plan to arrive early if your kids want one.
Where is Blue Heron Park in Avon?

Blue Heron Park is at 6570 E U.S. Highway 36 in Avon, Indiana. The town calendar used to call it Avon Town Hall Park, and some older posts still use that name. It is the park that hosts the town's tree lighting, with a lake that the carriage rides circle.
Where can kids meet Santa in Avon?

Kids can meet Santa at the Blue Heron Park tree lighting, at Sensory Santa at Pecar Nature Center on December 5, at Breakfast with Santa at Bartlett Chapel on December 5, and at Santa's Workshop with Avon Parks and Recreation on December 19. Each card on this page lists its own time, cost and link.
Are there free Christmas events for kids in Avon?

Yes. The tree lighting is free to attend, Sensory Santa at Pecar Nature Center is free, and the Breakfast with Santa at Bartlett Chapel is free. Carriage rides, the Polar Express Experience and Santa's Workshop carry a charge, and a few listings do not print a price, so those are marked Price not listed.
Is there a Christmas train near Avon?

Avon has no Christmas train of its own. The closest one in our guide is Nickel Plate Express in Noblesville, which runs the Reindeer Express in the Christmas season. Avon's Polar Express Experience at Washington Township Park is a themed family event, so it is a good pick for kids who like the story but not the travel.
